name: Okada Yuuta
source:
Ryouko's husband. When he was a student, he admired her and confessed his feelings for her and they entered into a relationship.

After a whirlwind romance, he proposed to her when he turned 20 years old after entering university and join. They are planning to hold a small ceremony after graduation.

He is currently in the hospital after a motorcycle accident, but he does not know that Ryouko has turned to prostitution to pay for the damages.
